0022600114.text: The Knicks host the Orlando Magic in New York's third game of the season, with both teams at 0-2 and on two-game losing streaks. New York is 0-1 at home and sits 12th in the East, 2.5 games back in the Atlantic, while Orlando is 13th in the East and 2 games back in the Southeast. Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain) is day-to-day for the Knicks and a game-time decision, while the Magic are missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Anthony Black (ankle sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 and split their four 2025-26 games 2-2, with the Knicks' most recent meeting a 132-120 win in Orlando on December 13, 2025.
